title_zh: 为营销毕业生确定求职第一步

scenario.label_zh: 安排营销毕业生的求职准备
scenario.goal_zh: 根据经验和收入需求筛选入门岗位，并确定准备作品和咨询职位的下一步

context_zh: 刚毕业的卢卡向职业顾问贝拉咨询求职方向。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I am a recent graduate, and most of the jobs I find seem to ask for experience.

sentences.speaker: Bella
sentences.text: What did you study, and what kind of work interests you?

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Marketing. I enjoyed planning campaigns, but I have no experience in management.

sentences.speaker: Bella
sentences.text: Then look at assistant roles rather than positions where you would lead a team.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Some of the internships are unpaid. I need to earn a living, so those are not realistic for me.

sentences.speaker: Bella
sentences.text: Let us filter for paid entry-level work. Do you have a project you could show an employer?

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: I created a campaign for our student theatre. I could put the posters and results together.

sentences.speaker: Bella
sentences.text: Do that first. Then choose two suitable listings, and we can check the requirements together on Friday.

sentences.speaker: Luca
sentences.text: Thanks. I will bring the project and two listings to our Friday appointment.
